name: alpha-sweep
airframe: any jet - fly it LOADED (heavy stores) for the loaded-jet case
note: THE highest-value card: aoaLimiterActivePct is 0 in every capture ever taken. Same stimulus shape as fixedwing-sweep (deriveAzRate = 0.6 of the airframe's own instantaneous rate, i.e. a fixed fraction of ITS structural g), flown at 8000 m instead of 4000. Thin air means that fraction is no longer available aerodynamically, so the wing rides its alpha ceiling and stays there as energy bleeds. Pass = aoaAboveCeilingPct > 0 on alphaHold; 0 means the card failed to reach the regime, not that the law is clean.
